pageTitle: My First Pot — Back to Roots

program.title: My First Pot
program.description: Experience the ancient art of pottery through hands-on clay work that connects children to traditional craftsmanship. Develop patience, creativity, and tactile skills while creating their very first functional pottery piece to treasure.
program.imageAlt: Children creating their first pottery pieces

items.title: Clay Introduction Circle
items.description: Feel the magic of clay, learn about this ancient material, and discover how pottery has been part of human culture for thousands of years.

items.title: Hand-Building Techniques
items.description: Master basic pottery techniques like pinching, coiling, and shaping to create your very first functional pot using traditional methods.

items.title: Decoration & Painting
items.description: Add personal touches to your pot with natural glazes, traditional patterns, and creative designs that reflect your unique personality.

items.title: Potter's Pride Ceremony
items.description: Celebrate your creation in a special ceremony, learn about the firing process, and take home your very first handmade pottery piece.

items.label: What to bring
items.value: Old clothes, apron, water bottle, towel

items.label: Take home
items.value: Handcrafted pottery piece, clay care guide, potter's certificate
